title: Benidorm Radial Finestrat Network - Lines 014 and 015
notes: Finestrat discovery component for the Benidorm legacy scenario family.
Both routes use independently ordered official ida/vuelta patterns with closesLoop false.
Line 014 links Finestrat Pueblo, Golf Bahía, Cala de Finestrat and western Benidorm to Salto del Agua.
Line 015 links Hotel Bali and the coastal/commercial corridor with Golf Bahía, Balcón de Finestrat, Terra Natura, Les Tapiades and Finestrat Pueblo.
Optional representation metadata. It is not authoritative simulation state.
Package identity moved into the Benidorm radial family; route, pattern, stop, coordinate and settlement data are otherwise unchanged.
